entries.title: The Messenger
entries.definitive_edition: The Messenger on Windows PC with Picnic Panic DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Picnic Panic installed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with free DLC content.

primary.version: Current PC release plus Picnic Panic DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archival version because it covers the base game and the free Picnic Panic expansion while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility. Picnic Panic adds three new levels, three new boss fights, new enemies, music, and story content; the console routes do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Messenger on Steam for Windows PC, install the free Picnic Panic DLC, finish the main game, then access Picnic Panic from the shop/scrying orb route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; install Picnic Panic for the complete content route.
